description: This file is a shell script that manages Quality of Service (QoS) configuration and network interface setup for OpenWrt systems. It includes functions for loading kernel modules, configuring network interfaces, applying traffic rules using iptables, and managing queuing disciplines.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Adds a kernel module, ensuring it is only loaded once by tracking with insmod flags.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Finds network device name for a given interface; sourced from network configuration.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Parses and appends iptables rules based on matching criteria and options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Callback to set default configurations for interface and classify types.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration sections and sets up interfaces accordingly.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates classes for a given configuration section.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Defines class variables such as packet size, rate, and priority for QoS classes.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules using an awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes and starts QoS configurations on a specific network interface.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Starts QoS on all configured interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds iptables rules for a specified set of QoS rules.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts a class group, setting up iptables rules and traffic control configurations.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Initializes firewall rules and iptables chains for QoS.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related iptables rules and deletes chains.
